native_xrpl_lending_protocol.structure: fixed-term uncollateralized loans funded by pooled Single Asset Vault deposits
native_xrpl_lending_protocol.underwriting: off-chain borrower underwriting and risk management
native_xrpl_lending_protocol.first_loss_capital: optional broker-provided buffer; does not eliminate credit risk
native_xrpl_lending_protocol.implications: XRP may be deposited as a vault asset, but this does not make the native Lending Protocol an XRP-collateralized lending system.

single_asset_vault.role: aggregates depositor assets for use by connected protocols
single_asset_vault.implication: XRP can be lendable pool inventory; that is distinct from borrowers posting XRP collateral.
